note: DRAFT — Meadows is a set of connected side-scrolling areas, not one long strip. monster_ids must already exist on the monsters tab; spawn_counts are v0 placeholders (on-map at once, not a daily cap). connections are walking paths / portals to adjacent areas. Town is a safe hub with the NPC shop. Names are plain and low-tier. Only Meadows is laid out in v0; later worlds get their own rows. All values are placeholders. v0.2.0: Dirt Banks is playable (portal from the east pasture). Meadow Shrine and further east remain closed.  v0.2.4: Dirt Banks also spawns Spark Bug (3) and Frost Moth (3). Meadow Shrine stays closed.  v0.2.6: Frost Moth leaves the Dirt Banks (Banks 20 regulars: mole 6, sprite 5, beetle 5, spark bug 4).  v0.3.0: Sunny Pasture and Dirt Banks split into Meadow West / Meadow East and Dirt Banks West / East, with vertical levels; Whisperwood branches north from Meadow East. Meadow East adds Meadow Boar 4 (terraces) and the Old Stump (grove).  v0.3.1: Sunny Pasture (3-5) returns far west; Meadow West moves west of town (mirrored); Meadow East: crow 4, wool_sheep 4, boar 4, angry_bull 1, no Old Stump.

rows.name: Sunny Pasture
rows.notes: v0.3.1: the far-west pasture, a dead end. A wider, gently rolling meadow with two low ledges and no climbing; Boars at the far end.

rows.name: Meadow Town
rows.notes: The starting hub. No combat. Mara's shop, Calden the trainer, Ila at the exchange bench, Tamsin. Pell stands at the west gate (v0.3.1). Players spawn and respawn here. West gate → Meadow West, east gate → Meadow East.

rows.name: Meadow West
rows.notes: v0.3.1: moved west of town and mirrored; the town gate is on its east edge. Mice by the gate, sheep in the middle, two crows at the far-left end. Flat, no climbing. The first hunt.

rows.name: Meadow East
rows.connections: west: meadow_town; east: dirt_banks_west; north: whisperwood
rows.notes: v0.3.0: hilly. v0.3.1: Crows and Wool Sheep on the ground (Wool-Shoulder on the far ground), Boars on the terraces, one Angry Bull in the raised grove where the Old Stump was. The Whisperwood road starts behind the grove.

rows.name: Dirt Banks West
rows.notes: v0.3.0: the riverbank. A shallow river along the bottom, mud shelves above it, high bank ledges tied together with root ladders. What the Banks Hide and The Cracked Stone gathering happen here.

rows.name: Dirt Banks East
rows.notes: v0.3.0: a cave. Cave floor, upper galleries by rope (Cinderback), and a lower pit you drop into (Bank-Cracker’s den). The Meadow Shrine past it stays closed.

rows.name: Whisperwood
rows.notes: v0.3.0: misty forest north of Meadow East. Wren’s camp at the edge. Forest floor (Wisps at the entrance, Thornlings, Mire Toads in the bog), canopy in tiers (Moss Lurkers, Wisps), and the Hollow past the bog (Hollow Stag). Opens with Mist on the North Road.

rows.name: Meadow Shrine
rows.notes: A small old shrine in a quieter part of the meadow. Frost Moths in the morning dew, Spark Bugs along the stones, Shrine Wisps close to the shrine itself. No new shop — return to town through the path.

rows.name: Dusk Margin
rows.notes: The dim eastern edge of the meadow. Meadow Boars root the brush, a few Spark Bugs still snap in the grass, and Dusk Wisps drift as the light falls. The path north leads to the boss clearing. Spark Bugs also appear at Meadow Shrine — overlapping, not the whole zone.

rows.name: Stump Hollow
rows.notes: A small clearing with one old stump. Old Stump (nature boss, the only Heartwood source) is here during the day. At night the same stump is the Night Stump (spiritual boss; Cursed Dust once Heartwood is owned). Two Meadow Boars at the rim, not in the boss pit. Bosses cannot be leashed out of this area. Intended for late Meadows.
